description: This file defines the RmiServiceEngine class, which extends a generic asynchronous engine to facilitate remote method invocation (RMI) for services within the Apache OFBiz framework. It handles locating remote dispatchers, invoking services remotely, and managing exceptions related to RMI operations.

classes.name: RmiServiceEngine
classes.description: A class extending GenericAsyncEngine to implement remote method invocation (RMI) integration for service calls within the OFBiz framework. It manages lookup and invocation of services on remote servers via RMI, handling exceptions and returning service results.

methods.name: RmiServiceEngine
methods.description: Constructor initializing the engine with a service dispatcher.

methods.name: runSync
methods.description: Executes a service synchronously, returning the result map. Delegates to the 'run' method.

methods.name: runSyncIgnore
methods.description: Runs a service synchronously but ignores the result, mainly for side-effect execution.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Handles the core logic of locating the remote dispatcher via RMI, invoking the remote service, and managing exceptions. Returns the result map.
